title: Open Carrier Data profile lookup (generated/android/lookup.json)
description: One entry per published carrier profile, for apps and tools that pick a profile from a SIM's facts. Since schema_version 2 (rule round 45, item 3) the profiles a SIM matches resolve generic to specific by weight, a carrier-ID selector above a raw profile of equal weight, the longer prefix or more fixed digits, fewer list values, fewer network codes, then profile_id (docs/data-model.md, tools/resolve_carrier_profiles.py); specificity stays the count of selectors used. profile_id is assigned once and kept (rule round 45); a retired ID is listed in aliases/ids.json with the profiles its SIMs match now. Key stored results by the SIM's facts and the release, and follow an alias only to update a link (docs/compatibility.md). tools/validate_public_carrier_data.py checks this schema and what a schema cannot: every published profile listed once, and newest_entry against the evidence index.

match_semantics.const: OR within a match list; AND between match dimensions

weight.description: Android's weight of the profile on each network code of its match (rule round 45): CarrierResolver's score of the fields it pins (MCC/MNC 256, IMSI prefix 128, ICCID prefix 64, GID1 32, GID2 16, SPN 2), a carrier-ID selector counted by the lowest-weight rule Android's carrier list (tools/aosp/carrier-id-table.json) has for that ID on that network. Step 1 of the resolution order announced in docs/compatibility.md.

depends_on.description: Rule round 45, item 4: why a conditional capability value is not single, only for capabilities whose value is conditional. device: carrier-variants.json records an on and an off on different devices of one software stack; firmware: it records one device on and off under different stacks; ims_stack: a record keyed by IMS stack backs it; sources_disagree: the evidence index records a conflict of source families, or nothing records another basis. tools/two_answers.py derives it; capabilities stays the configure answer, unchanged.

for_you.description: Rule round 45, item 4: whether this customer has the feature, as an admitted operator or brand statement that has not lapsed states it (generated/operators/statements.json), only where one gives a state; missing means unknown. It says what the brand states, never that the person's plan includes it, and never feeds capabilities, CarrierConfig, APN rows or the OCD dataset. reason brand_not_tellable with brands: a plain profile on a network where host-only brands ride, so the phone cannot tell whose SIM it is. tools/two_answers.py derives it.
